title: Data breach notification letter
description: Notice of Data Breach letter mailed to affected individuals by a bank, hospital, retailer, school or city, using the US state model-form headings (What Happened? / What Information Was Involved? / What We Are Doing. / What You Can Do. / For More Information.). One Letter page: keep each section to two or three sentences.

marking.description: Exercise marking printed at the top and bottom

org.description: Organization sending the notice (usually the exercising organization)

mailingId.description: Mail-house reference printed above the recipient block

recipientAddress.description: Addressee street, city, state and ZIP lines

intro.description: Opening paragraph after the salutation (one or two sentences)
examples: We are writing to tell you about a data security incident that may have involved some of your personal information.

whatHappened.description: What happened and when it was discovered
examples: On October 21, 2026, we detected unusual activity on a file server used by our loan operations team.
Your name, address, Social Security number and loan account number.

whatWeAreDoing.description: Containment, investigation, law-enforcement and regulator notice
examples: We took the server offline, engaged a forensic firm and notified the FBI.

whatYouCanDo.description: Steps the reader should take (credit monitoring, fraud alert, security freeze)
examples: Enroll in the free credit monitoring below and review your account statements.

forMoreInformation.description: Call-center hours and how to reach the organization
examples: Call our dedicated line, Monday–Friday 8 a.m.–8 p.m. ET.

enrollmentCode.description: Credit-monitoring activation code (shows the enrollment box)

monitoringProvider.description: Credit-monitoring service named in the enrollment box

callCenter.description: Toll-free number of the call center
